rationale: Verified evidence establishes that telemetry was valid immediately before the origin, then a constant-rate linear deceleration regime began at the origin and continues downward toward a zero floor. This specifically falsifies the host default's tapering power-tail assumption and supports the only candidate with a constant linear decrement. Although its 100-step forecast does not yet reach zero, it best matches the documented future regime without inventing an undocumented deceleration rate or stopping time.
